performance_case.causal_mechanism: A versioned task, schema, root and runner chain prevents the deployed V3R1 exporter from producing fourteen days of immutable forward evidence that the Local node cannot validate, receive, diagnose or interpret.
performance_case.claim_boundary: A positive implementation proves only one offline versioned V3R1 transfer-through-terminal-interpretation chain with synthetic fixtures and an exporter-to-Local equality gate. It does not prove live transfer, fourteen-day completion, prediction, fees, slippage, capacity, equal-capital PnL, drawdown improvement, candidate readiness, OOS value, deployment or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. The capability protects evidence delivery only; any strategy drawdown improvement remains MISSING_PROOF until a separately frozen evidence-ready candidate passes economic and path-risk gates.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: The bounded eleven-file implementation consumes one Local engineering cycle but prevents a likely fourteen-day evidence loss, removes a terminal-analysis bottleneck and stops before speculative positive-only downstream work.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The implementation cannot improve fee-adjusted total PnL directly; it reduces time-to-terminal-evidence and false-green risk so one completed V3R1 package can be evaluated once without identity or missingness drift.
